question: A policeman spots a thief at a distance of 200 m and starts chasing him. While the policeman runs at a speed of 9 km/h, the thief runs at a speed of 7 km/h. After how long will the policeman catch the thief?
solution:
Given:

Distance(d) = 200 m

Speed of the policeman(b) = 9 km/h

Speed of the thief(a) = 7 km/h

Formula Used :

(i) Time = d ÷ [(b - a)]

Calculations:

d = 200 m ,

⇒ a = 7 km/h = 7 × 5/18 = 35/18 m/s

⇒ b = 9 km/h = 9 × 5/18 = 5/2 m/s

According to the formula

Time = d ÷ (b - a)

Time = 200 ÷ (5/2 – 35/18)

Time = (200)/(frac{10){18}}

Time = 18 × 20

Time = 360 s = 360/60 = 6 minutes

Hence, The Police will take 6 minutes to catch thief.
